title: Governed Proposal, Decision, Action, Receipt, Outcome and Learning contracts
invariants_verified: Proposal records runtime identity, bounded intent, action/wait/handoff/child-Mission/completion proposal, risk hints, context references, citations and provenance without approval or receipt authority.
Only system or operator actors can issue Decisions.
Committed Actions require a matching Decision with allow or modify disposition and exact scope/identity binding.
Receipt types distinguish commit, tool, provider, delivery, usage, cost, audit and outcome evidence.
Outcome is evidence-backed and distinct from message delivery.
LearningProposal acceptance requires an independent governed reviewer; runtime cannot self-accept its own proposal.
Contract digests are deterministic and receipt integrity is verifiable.
